{{:Eternal}}
===Eternals Interested in the Empire===
This list of eternals is not exhaustive; rather it lists some of those beings who have shown a special interest in the Empire since its formation.

The creature known as ''Capradan, the Horned Hunter'', is a being of the Spring realm whose true nature is unclear. It is either a very potent herald or a lesser eternal concerned with primitive concepts of hunting and killing for sustenance. There is an eternal known in the [[Sumaah Republic]] called ''[[Satraps of the Abyss#Of Spring|Wind Panther]]'' that is not involved with the Empire.

The Sumaah Republic apparently associates with ''[[Satraps of the Abyss#Of Night|Deep Drummer]]'', who may be an aspect of [[Janon]] and deals with celebration and catharsis. In the Sarcophan Delves there are three Night eternals unknown in the Empire - ''[[Eternals_of_the_sea#Sailor_on_the_Skerries|Dathan]], the Sailor on the Skerries (wonder, joy); ''[[Eternals_of_the_sea#Hongerigespin_and_Ungholt|Ungholt]]'', the Delerium King (terror, nightmare, madness); and ''Hongerigespin'' (memory, forgetfulness, obfuscation). There is also reference to the ''Lantern Shark'' whose qualities are unknown.

<small>
#{{anchor|1}} Prior to 384YE Ylenwe used the name Ylenrith and was strongly associated with purity.
#{{anchor|2}} In 382YE, two other eternals of the Night realm - [[Murit]] the Shaper and [[Soghter]], Changer of the Ways - were unified into [[Azoth]] with the assistance of Imperial magicians.
</small>
